preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are within bounds, and total actions q is within bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t, _, _, _, _ in actions)
preconditions.description: Each action type t is either 1 (place barrier), 2 (remove barrier), or 3 (query path).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= c2 <= m for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions)
preconditions.description: Coordinates r1, c1, r2, c2 are within grid bounds and r1 <= r2, c1 <= c2 for all actions.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n - 1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m - 1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t in {1, 2})
preconditions.description: For barrier actions (t=1 or t=2), coordinates are strictly within the inner grid (not on the boundary).

preconditions.expression: all(actions[i][0] == 2 implies (r1, c1, r2, c2) in existing_barriers for i in range(len(actions)) if actions[i][0] == 2)
preconditions.description: A barrier removal (t=2) only occurs if the specified barrier exists in the current set of barriers.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] in {'Yes', 'No'} for i in range(len(query_indices)))
postconditions.description: For each query (t=3), output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[i] == 'Yes') == is_path_possible(actions[:query_indices[i]], query_indices[i]) for i in range(len(query_indices)))
postconditions.description: For each query (t=3), output 'Yes' if there exists a path from (r1, c1) to (r2, c2) without crossing any barriers, otherwise 'No'.

invariants.expression: all(2 <= r <= n - 1 and 2 <= c <= m - 1 for (r, c) in barrier_corners)
invariants.description: Barriers are always placed strictly within the inner grid (not on the boundary).

invariants.expression: all(not (r1 <= r <= r2 and c1 <= c <= c2) or (r, c) not in barrier_corners for (r1, c1, r2, c2) in existing_barriers for (r, c) in barrier_corners)
invariants.description: Barriers do not intersect or share common points with other barriers.
